data_fields.name: max road distance to nearest town
terrain clear radius around a landmark

best_idea: Landmarks are placed one at a time by rejection sampling inside their biome with a no-fly box around each one, then each town links to its nearest town within a road distance cap and every other landmark links to its nearest town, with minimap markers drawn from the same placement.
decision_why: One-at-a-time landmark placement with a spacing box, a capped nearest-town road rule and minimap markers fits zones as data and gives a readable world network from one server seed; the donor's broken neighbour search, silent drop, skipped last items, reserved-but-undrawn road edge and structure tiling bugs are fixed in the sketch or the fix list, and the client-side generator is moved to the server.
acceptance: Given one seed the server places the same towns, landmarks and roads in a zone; every town, including the last one listed, links to its nearest town within 1000 px; a server test fails if any landmark is missing without a rerun, and each town's minimap marker sits on its tile.
